{{Top|leg}}
'''Net suits''' were used by the [[Qwohog (species)|Qwohog]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to protect themselves from [[Salt/Legends|salt]] [[Water/Legends|water]]. The Qwohog lived in freshwater and found the salinity of salt water to be caustic to gill slits and [[Lung/Legends|lungs]]. Net suits were elaborate filter systems that prevented salt water from touching their skin.
